notes.title: Raccoon Update
notes.notes:
Todays update was made by raccoons, for raccoons.

New Area - Alley

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/d0b9b48cbf4e90039cb25ae98c3317f128db03a4.png

Alley
Theme: ????

This is a secret area that you need to do something secret to get a chance to access. Has a secret item if you get here too!

It's also completely dark and has a roaming giant raccoon monster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/cc770e4c321a8fffd16d09170f7b474e87511de6.png

New Items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/469ed4c43fbffc49501059a2785caad7f5302d0e.png
DarZo Phaser
Freezes most entities. This is one of the first rare spawning items. This design shape was slightly inspired from that gun in that Fifth Element movie because I was rewatching that while making new models.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/4ee81340a90fda2b2bebbfb3681a55d94a5e6a81.png
TeleDisc
Use this to teleport you back to the Neet Mobile from where ever you are. So if you are in the Neet Mobile and want to teleport to the Neet Mobile now is your chance!

Other New Things

First of Clown Conditions was added. Your Status Screen in the Mobile Cockpit will show if you have a condition.

The first one is gained if you find one of these strange Tailed Totems. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/a16a488d09aed83d9fe7c2f4820af818ac10240f.png

New Cosmetic - Raccoon Tail

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/c50ebde9e6853360860e36025047f46a68d5c8b5.png

Forgot what this was priced at

There is now a Hard Win stat that tracks wins in hard mode.

New Achievements:
Harden: Win first runs in Hard Mode.
Hardened: Win 10 runs in Hard Mode.
Dark Alley: Discover the Alley Location.

Also going to redo the prev achievement icons cause didn't really like how they turned out.

More Changes and Additions


Hard Mode has a level 5 clown requirement now.
Neet Mobile Weight Limit is now 5.
Normie Potion now has a visible effect when used.
Added more ways to gain experience. Can no longer gain experience when completing <2 areas.
Removed Potato from discoveries and added Fries.
You can now no longer visit the same area twice in a normal run. This will later be added to harder modes.
Gremlins can now open doors.
Redid item spawning so equipment should be slightly more common.


Bug Fixes


Fixed Clients crashing on Park, Cat Litter and a few others. There was a weird error on the Park and it deleted all Entity spawns so had to replace them. Tried to remember where they originally were but they might be diff. Also Duck easter egg no longer happens on the night version of this area.
Fixed winning run stat not counting on clients sometimes.
Fixed a bunch of other errors that were mostly caused by the new projectiles (Gremlin Balls and Fiend Bottles). Redid projectile stuff so that shouldn't happen anymore.
Fixed Giant Brains not seeing clowns. This was due to trying to fix their voice lines overlapping.


Lastly
Next update will either be a Boss monster OR karma related stuff. Also going to probably do something with Capybaras because who doesn't like capybaras.

🦝🦝🦝🦝

notes.notes:
Hi how do is? How do is you are be

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/49c1c9432dd9ef789557299ad280e5a3551f9a22.png

If you have this on board the Neet Mobile when you finish a run it will give you extra experience. This stacks too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/8f9c1bb5d2fd6fe25755a01ad8f6b76383de2290.png
Time Capsule
You can install this in the new Capsule Panel on the Neet Mobile to give you more time in the current area. There will prob be more Capsules in the future.

New Features, Talents and Stuff

INVENTORY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/098573d838a18a5a89b8435ac0cd932954863ae1.png
You can hold up to 3 items at a time. You can hold 4 if you purchase the Society Inventory Bundle™ for $24.99! [spoiler]Ecks Dee it's actually a talent[/spoiler]

Use the number keys to switch between them. You'll drop everything when destroyed by society. Also you still can't carry extra Relics between areas.

New Talents
Satchel
Carry up to 4 items in your inventory

Potent Potency
Positive Status Effects last longer. (Like the normie potion and Knowledge)

Capsule Panel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/dec637caeebad43c5692879b0e6d81155b204636.png
There's a new thing on the Neet Mobile where you can install capsules. There's only 1 capsule atm

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/cc7439d44d1bf81981f7ca461b55245d8a86ac0c.png
Added a thing in the Neet Mobile showing society difficulty.


Difficulty selector buttons now light up when hovering them.
Positive Status Effects are now Green and Negative ones are red on the Hud.
Inspection Text on the Hud is now larger.
Grocery Shopping should now be way less laggy. Merged and remade a lot of models there.
Added more ways to earn exp.


Bug Fixes

Ball and Bottle projectiles no longer play their sounds globally.
Fiend can take damage now.
Weapon reach should now sync with Crosshair turning red.
Fixed bugs relating to attacking Entities that can't be damaged.
Canaries now always play their attack sounds.
Fixed Clients not loading areas and other bugs with them not syncing to the host. The new Difficulty variable wasn't a network variable so not everyone was synced but it be fixed now.
Fixed clients not being seen by Entities. One of the reasons for this is because client players were still being shown as sitting on the lobby chairs.


Lastly
That's it for this update or patch or what ever you want to call it, stay tuned for more

notes.title: New Patch - Cosmetics, Talents, Leveling and More!
notes.notes:
Hello PEOPLE

New patch with lots, LOTS

First off, many new UI things, talent tree, dress up, etc. BUT the graphics for them are for testing and aren't final (because they change a lot). SO MAKE A NOTE OF THAT AND NO MAKING FUN OF THEM

Cosmetics

Made a new cosmetic, dress up station area in the lobby:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/552b2b31a0ebcb38c5aeb5280d7e380f14c84723.png

Go there once you buy stuff from the store with money you collected from society runs. The store is on the start screen. There's 3 hats atm. Tree, Cupcake and Top Hat.

Talents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/1b1935f3adc2eb6978057c049b4250c8e3782ec6.png

There's a talent tree now, every time you go on a run you'll gain experience, when you level up you'll get a knowledge point to spend there. You start at Level 1 with 1 Knowledge point to spend.

There's 6 talents:

Flashlight: Start with a flashlight. This is already unlocked for everyone.

Respawn+: Your respawn timer will increase much slower.

Go Fast I: Move faster.

Stable Feet: No longer slip on puddles.

Heat Resistance: No longer affected by anything fire or heat related (Hot Oil, Flames, Grills)

Crouch Ninja: Move at the same speed as if you were walking when crouch.

HINT: Crouch will become useful in the upcoming area.

Select talents on your screen in the lobby.

Cloud Saves are Enabled

Experience, Levels, Collected money and everything is save enabled now.

Max Level is 5 (Temporary)
Max Money is 1000 (Temporary)

There's now a stat screen on the Start menu.

Other Additions

Timer now shows up on your HUD:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/1a130ed485f120baf935e7d57a7d9efd37b7e92d.png
The timer will be there on easy runs but in the future, harder runs you won't have this, so you'll need to plan. Easy runs are default right now.

Flashlights no longer spawn for everyone, they will only spawn if you have the talent.
Lockers in the Neet Mobile now display your name instead of CLOWN.
Countdown counts down slower.
New Clown Poster in the Lobby

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5f52bfa0348857b5d90f383cb56dcad2e96f0f76.png

Bug Fixes


Out of bounds colliders are enabled on Litter Box area.
The new relics will spawn for clients now.
Crashes relating to new relics fixed

Also hats sort of glitch when you are riding up the Neet Mobile chairs, caught this way too late. Will be fixed on next patch.

Report any bugs on Steam Discussions.
Also give suggestions on balance for exp needed for leveling up and cosmetic prices.

Lastly

Next update will have a new area and a new entity.
